FN-1M5W3ZL-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 166
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative Jim Hill
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 02/20/2024
House Bill 166 as introduced proposes a Constitutional Amendment, which if ratified, would
provide for the Legislature to set or alter the compensation of county officers or sheriffs by
general or local legislation, effective on the following term of office.
Further, this amendment would increase the proclamation expenses of the Governor, paid from
the State General Fund, by an estimated $100,000 for fiscal year 2025.
Page 1
